mapper.sql: id, title, description, category, task_type, task_status, task_group, task_priority, task_progress, sub_task_group, planned_start_time, planned_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, actual_duration, parent_id, user_id, is_delay_processed, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND task_type = #{taskType} AND planned_start_time <= CONCAT(#{date}, ' 23:59:59') AND planned_end_time >= CONCAT(#{date}, ' 00:00:00') ORDER BY task_priority DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE task SET task_status = 4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND task_status < 3 AND DATE(planned_end_time) = #{today}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND task_type = 5 AND task_status = 4 AND is_delay_processed = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY planned_end_time ASC
